column1: # Buccino et al. (2016) fNIRS probe: which optodes form each channel, as 10-5 sites.
# Reconstructed from Fig 1 of the paper (doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0146610): 6 sources
# and 6 detectors per hemisphere on the rows FFC, FCC, CCP, CPP. The figure draws the
# channels of the left hemisphere only; the right hemisphere mirrors them. A label
# names the cell around a 10-10 site and its side: C3A is the anterior side of the
# cell around C3 (Anterior, Posterior, Lateral, Medial).
# Checked against Buccino's thesis (Fig 3.5a and the text beside it), which draws both
# hemispheres: a 4 by 3 grid per hemisphere, sources and detectors alternating, corner
# sources with 2 detectors and internal ones with 4. The thesis lists the 34 channels
# left to right, top to bottom (its fourth entry, a second Fc3A, is a typo for Fc4A);
# the data files store them left hemisphere first. The layout is matched by name, so
